Using GITHUB Hosted Runners : 
  runs-on : ubuntu-latest/any image
Using Self-Hosted Runner : 
  runs-on : self-hosted
On adding a self-hosted runner in Github, one can find the commands/instructions to run in the self-hosted machine/EC2 instance in the Github UI. Follow that and you will be able to connect Github to your
self-hosted runner and can run job on that machine.
